bounded_host_request.command:
set -u
docker exec debug-ai-debug-ai-1 node -e 'const e=process.env;const u=[e.DEBUG_AI_CORE_GATE_CODER_URL,e.DEBUG_AI_CORE_GATE_QWEN3_URL,e.DEBUG_AI_CORE_GATE_GRANITE_URL,e.DEBUG_AI_CORE_GATE_MINISTRAL_URL];if(!e.AI_CORE_API_KEY||u.some(x=>!x))process.exit(42);Promise.all(u.map(async x=>{try{const r=await fetch(new URL("/v1/models",x),{method:"GET",headers:{Authorization:"Bearer "+e.AI_CORE_API_KEY},signal:AbortSignal.timeout(3000)});return r.status;}catch{return 0;}})).then(a=>{if(a.every(x=>x===200))process.exit(0);if(a.includes(401))process.exit(31);if(a.includes(429))process.exit(32);if(a.includes(503))process.exit(33);if(a.includes(0))process.exit(40);process.exit(34);}).catch(()=>process.exit(49));' >/dev/null 2>&1
exit $?
